explication: 90DaysOfDevOps is a hands-on learning challenge, not a software runtime: learners work through daily tasks and topic tracks, practice DevOps skills, and publish proof of work. The README describes a 90-day sequence and broad learning outcomes; the tree also contains 2023–2026 materials and 2025 topic-based tracks. Links below reflect the documented participation flow and curriculum, not inspected task-level implementations.
